text:
Hi all,

My Israeli wife has an appointment on the 11th August to hand in my documents to hopefully get my B1 visa. From our understanding, that visa will be for 6 months and then we will have an interview for the A5 visa. 

My question is, am I allowed to travel back to the UK for Christmas to see family during this 6 month period between the B1 and A5, and is there any permission I need to leave during this period?

Secondly, assuming I am granted entrance to Israel in August. My dad and brother want to visit me and my wife in Israel in September. But my dad has a UK criminal record from a while back, most recent offence would be 10+ years ago. Can this cause any issues with him entering the country and is this declared on the ETA? I want them to plan a trip minimising the chance he would be denied entry.

Thanks,
Kai
